verdict.gold_reason: Article 72(2) of Regulation 2015/1222 says the TSO invoking force majeure or an emergency must publish a notice that is made available to the market participants concerned through NEMOs. If capacity is explicitly allocated, the TSO also sends notice directly to the contractual parties holding capacity. This matches the reference answer.

other_articles.why: Article 56(2) requires the TSO to publish a notification of the force majeure, but it names no channel such as NEMOs, so it does not answer the 'through which parties' question.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is paraphrased (booked border room = allocated cross-zonal capacity, sudden cut = curtailment). It does not say whether it means day-ahead or forward capacity, but only Article 72 names the NEMO channel.
